name: How long does a kitchen sink and faucet installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen sink and faucet installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing an existing kitchen sink and faucet typically takes two to four hours. The timeframe depends directly on whether you are doing a direct replacement or changing styles. Swapping an identical drop-in sink with compatible supply lines is fast, but transitioning from an overmount to an undermount model requires cutting, modifying, or refinishing countertop edges. Additional tasks such as installing a garbage disposal, running lines for a water filtration system, or updating old shut-off valves under the sink will also add time to the job.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard sink and faucet swap takes 2 to 4 hours. Modifying countertops or adding filtration units can extend installation time.
